native: The pin filters recall candidates only by lifecycle and ACL; it consults no tombstone registry, so a card forgotten from the active writer returns through a retained legacy or cross-namespace copy.

Native recall masks every row whose owner's registry holds a committed deletion of its id, after the ACL: vector search in every namespace, the refined second search, graph endpoints and graph hydration. Warm reranking already blocks committed and attempted deletions.

The lookup is the memory readers' (`TombstoneRegistry::find_by_origin(id, false)` for the row's agentId or storedBy) on the same store base. Masked rows are recorded only as id with stage `tombstone` and reason `tombstoned`; they are not rendered, counted by A1 or announced.
An unreadable registry fails the recall stage; the process answers the degraded error result without data. Canonical knowledge sections carry no memory id and are not masked.
